## Key data decisions

- **The source file is never changed.** It is read from outside the repository; its fingerprint is recorded, and every recode is made in code with the original value kept beside it.
- **Item rules in one table** (`spec/item_spec.csv`): wording, waves, range, reversal and special codes. The scripts read the rules from this table.
- **Anomie items 4-5 are already reverse-scored in the extract.** Reversing them as the guide suggests produced negative correlations with the other items, so they are not reversed again (to confirm with PPBS).
- **Relative deprivation** is one item, reversed so that higher means more deprived; it correlates with household income at ρ ≈ -.63.
- **Rehabilitation:** "not able to answer" is coded 97 in waves 4-5 but stored as blank in wave 3.
- **Causal attribution:** two separate scores (societal, individual) instead of one, based on factor analysis; items 2 and 3 left out.
- **Vote intention:** wave 1 had no "don't know" or "would not vote" option, so switching uses waves 2-5; models use construct scores from the wave *before* the vote.
- **Sample:** all 500 respondents took part in all five waves; results describe this panel, not the population.
- **Public site:** aggregate results only; groups below 10 respondents are hidden; an automatic check scans the built site for data files and respondent IDs before publishing.
